title: On-Demand Local Services & EV Roadside Dispatch
name: On-Demand Local Services & EV Roadside Dispatch
user_prompt: Build an on-demand roadside assistance, mechanic, and EV fast-charging locator app centered in Seattle. Allow drivers to set or drag their breakdown/current location pin on the map (reverse-geocoding the address) or search via Places Autocomplete. Search and display nearby EV charging stations and auto repair providers within a configurable 5km to 15km radius using Places API (New), showing station/provider details, ratings, and availability badges. Rank nearby options by real driving ETA using the Routes API, and draw the turn-by-turn dispatch or navigation route polyline from the driver's pin to the selected station or service provider.

expectations: Interactive map shows user pin, proximity search ring, and nearby EV/service Advanced Markers
Address search and draggable or clickable user location with reverse geocoding work
Sidebar displays real nearby EV charging or auto service details and ratings
Providers/stations show calculated driving distance and ETA
Selecting a station or provider draws the route polyline on the map
